events.title: 삼대째 진나라 장군 집안에서 태어나다
events.title_en: Born into a family that had served as Qin generals for three generations
events.description: 본래 제나라 출신이던 조부 몽오가 진나라로 건너가 장수가 된 이래, 아버지 몽무에 이어 그도 진나라 장군 가문에서 태어났다. 태어난 해는 정확히 전하지 않는다.
events.description_en: His grandfather Meng Ao, originally from Qi, had crossed into Qin and become a general there; his father Meng Wu carried on the line, and he was born into this family of Qin generals. The exact year of his birth is not recorded.

events.title: 제나라 정벌에 공을 세워 내사가 되다
events.title_en: He was named Neishi for his role in conquering Qi
events.description: 진나라가 마지막 남은 제나라를 칠 때 장군으로 나서 공을 세웠다. 이 공으로 수도권을 다스리는 내사에 임명됐다.
events.description_en: When Qin struck down Qi, the last of the six rival states, he served as a general and distinguished himself. For this he was appointed Neishi, overseeing the capital region.

events.title: 삼십만 대군으로 흉노를 북으로 몰아내다
events.title_en: He drove the Xiongnu north with an army of three hundred thousand
events.description: 통일된 진나라의 명으로 삼십만 대군을 이끌고 북방 흉노를 쳐서 하남 땅을 되찾았다.
events.description_en: On the order of the newly unified Qin, he led an army of three hundred thousand against the Xiongnu in the north and recovered the Hetao region.

events.title: 장성을 하나로 이어 만리장성을 쌓다
events.title_en: He linked the frontier walls into the Great Wall
events.description: 흉노를 몰아낸 뒤 조·연·진 세 나라가 저마다 쌓았던 장성을 서쪽 임조에서 동쪽 요동까지 하나로 이었다. 이것이 만리장성의 원형이 됐다.
events.description_en: After pushing back the Xiongnu, he linked the separate walls once built by the states of Zhao, Yan, and Qin into a single line running from Lintao in the west to Liaodong in the east. This became the original Great Wall.

events.title: 북방 변경에서 부소를 감군으로 맞다
events.title_en: Prince Fusu came to the frontier to oversee his army
events.description: 진시황을 거스른 죄로 변경에 보내진 태자 부소가 그의 군영에 감군으로 왔다. 두 사람은 변경에서 함께 지냈다.
events.description_en: Prince Fusu, sent to the frontier for defying Qin Shi Huang, came to serve as overseer of his army. The two men lived on the frontier together.

events.title: 진시황이 죽고 조서가 조작되다
events.title_en: Qin Shi Huang died and the succession was forged
events.description: 진시황이 순행 중 죽자 조고와 이사, 호해가 유서를 조작해 부소와 그에게 죽음을 명하는 거짓 조서를 내렸다.
events.description_en: When Qin Shi Huang died during a tour of the empire, Zhao Gao, Li Si, and Prince Huhai forged his will and issued a false edict ordering Fusu and him to die.

events.title: 부소와 함께 죽음을 맞다
events.description: 부소는 조서를 의심하지 않고 스스로 목숨을 끊었다. 그는 억울함을 호소하며 항변했으나 끝내 독을 마시고 죽었다.
events.description_en: Fusu, taking the edict at face value, took his own life without question. He protested his innocence but in the end was forced to drink poison and die.
